systems.country_label: Portal de Justiça / Portal da Justiça
systems.platform: www.justica.gov.cv, integrated with Autentika and the SIJ
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça; created by Decreto-Lei 53/2024 of 4 November
systems.tiers: national online, launched in Praia on 18 December 2024; birth, marriage, affiliation and death certificates, land, commercial, vehicle and criminal-record certificates, identity card renewal, and booking of services that must still be done in person
the State's authentication platform, used to sign in to the portal
lawyers follow their cases through it without travelling to the comarcas
